remarks: Welcome home to this beautiful, classic brick Cape Cod situated on a desirable corner lot in the heart of the Village of Lancaster. Brimming with warmth and incredible curb appeal, this versatile property offers the perfect combination of village convenience and income potential. Currently configured as a 2-family home with an upper 1-bedroom apartment, it can easily function as a high-earning multi-family property or convert seamlessly into a spacious single-family layout. Step inside to find warm, neutral tones and low-maintenance flooring flowing throughout the main level. The heart of the home is a bright, open kitchen featuring a skylight, sleek stainless-steel appliances, abundant cabinet storage, and a dining space large enough for a large table. Light pours into the expansive living room through floor-to-ceiling windows, while recessed lighting adds an inviting ambiance throughout. The main-floor full bathroom features unique navy tile accenting and a soaking tub framed by a decorative glass-block wall. Upstairs offers a separate 1-bedroom suite featuring a nice sized living space, an updated bathroom with a modern shower, generous closet storage, and a kitchen that can easily be transformed into an additional bedroom, nursery, or primary bonus room. Outside, enjoy a private, fully vinyl-fenced backyard complete with a patio and a detached 2-car garage. Additional features include a full basement with laundry hookups, expansive storage, and a newer forced-air furnace (2025) and new gutters (2023). Live in one unit and rent the other or make it your dream single-family home—the options are endless. Upstairs will stay completely furnished for the new buyer with everything from the appliances to the silverware.  Best of all, you are just blocks from Broadway with easy walking access to local dining, events, and shopping in the Village of Lancaster. Showings begin immediately!  Also listed as a single-family B1712604.
